scope: All 277 disjoint three-strand f3 placements at thirteen labels, both cut orientations and the two identity pairings, over F16. The 4086-piece span has exact dimension 4014 and does not contain the crossing, while the 146-piece prefix span has dimension 146 and also misses it. A stored separating functional vanishes on every piece and evaluates to 4 on the crossing. No rank-sum optimum, uniform family, or stronger factoring score is claimed.
